Review this change for security vulnerabilities.

Changed files (you may Read these and any other file in the repo):
  - .github/workflows/deploy-coolify.yml

Unified diff (only + lines are new):

=== DIFF: .github/workflows/deploy-coolify.yml ===
@@ -322,6 +322,52 @@ jobs:
             echo "**Trigger:** Push to ${{ github.ref_name }} ($([ '${{ github.ref_name }}' = 'main' ] && echo 'full CI' || echo 'lint+typecheck+unit'))" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
           fi
 
+      # Coolify's app config points at the floating `:main` registry tag. A
+      # health-check-triggered container restart recreates the container
+      # from whatever image is locally cached under that tag WITHOUT going
+      # through this deploy pipeline — so a restart can silently resurrect
+      # stale code hours after a correct deploy, with no CI run, webhook, or
+      # API call to show for it. This happened on 2026-07-31: the RSC
+      # cache-poisoning fix (0cdf6f8e) deployed correctly at 14:34 UTC, then
+      # a restart at 19:01 UTC reverted it. Pinning to the immutable
+      # `sha-<commit>` tag (already pushed by build-and-push, above) before
+      # every deploy removes the floating tag a restart could resurrect.
+      # See docs/incidents/2026-04-04-cloudflare-rsc-cache-poisoning.md.
+      - name: Pin Coolify to this commit's immutable image tag
+        env:
+          COOLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN || secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}
+          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL || secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING }}
+        run: |
+          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
+            echo "::error::COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL secret is required"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          # The webhook URL is Coolify's own `POST /api/v1/deploy?uuid=...`
+          # trigger — reuse its host and uuid instead of adding new secrets.
+          COOLIFY_API_BASE=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '^https?://[^/]+')
+          COOLIFY_APP_UUID=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '(?<=[?&]uuid=)[^&]+')
+
+          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_API_BASE" ] || [ -z "$COOLIFY_APP_UUID" ]; then
+            echo "::error::Could not parse host/uuid out of COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL — expected .../api/v1/deploy?uuid=<uuid>. Refusing to deploy on the floating tag; fix the URL or this parsing."
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
+            -X PATCH "${COOLIFY_API_BASE}/api/v1/applications/${COOLIFY_APP_UUID}" \
+            -H "Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN" \
+            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
+            --data "{\"docker_registry_image_tag\": \"sha-${{ github.sha }}\"}" \
+            --max-time 15) || HTTP_CODE="000"
+
+          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 300 ]; then
+            echo "::error::Failed to pin docker_registry_image_tag (HTTP $HTTP_CODE) — aborting rather than deploying on the floating :main tag"
+            cat /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json 2>/dev/null || true
+            exit 1
+          fi
+
+          echo "Pinned esdeveniments-production to sha-${{ github.sha }}"
+
       - name: Trigger Coolify deployment
         env:
           COOLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN || secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}


Investigate per the method in your instructions, then return the findings list.

1	name: Deploy to Coolify
2	
3	on:
4	  push:
5	    branches: [main, develop]
6	    paths-ignore:
7	      - "**/*.md"
8	      - "docs/**"
9	      - ".claude/**"
10	      - ".github/skills/**"
11	      - ".vscode/**"
12	      - ".cursor/**"
13	      - "LICENSE"
14	  workflow_dispatch:
15	    inputs:
16	      skip_e2e:
17	        description: "Skip E2E tests (faster deploy)"
18	        type: boolean
19	        default: false
20	      skip_tests:
21	        description: "Skip ALL tests (lint + typecheck still run)"
22	        type: boolean
23	        default: false
24	      skip_ci:
25	        description: "Skip entire CI — deploy immediately (emergency only)"
26	        type: boolean
27	        default: false
28	
29	concurrency:
30	  group: deploy-coolify-${{ github.ref }}
31	  # Cancel superseded deploys. Coolify has a known stuck-build bug class
32	  # (coollabsio/coolify #5850, #6414, #6579) where overlapping Next.js
33	  # builds on the app server can wedge one build "In Progress" forever,
34	  # which in turn blocks Coolify's automatic Docker cleanup from running
35	  # and fills the disk. Cancelling in-flight deploys on a newer push is
36	  # safer than queueing them.
37	  cancel-in-progress: true
38	
39	# Explicit least-privilege permissions (security best practice)
40	permissions:
41	  contents: read
42	  actions: read
43	
44	env:
45	  NODE_VERSION: "22"
46	  IS_PRODUCTION: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' }}
47	  DEPLOY_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'https://www.esdeveniments.cat' || 'https://staging.esdeveniments.cat' }}
48	
49	jobs:
50	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
51	  # Quality gate: lint + typecheck (always runs unless skip_ci)
52	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
53	  quality:
54	    name: Lint & Typecheck
55	    if: ${{ !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.skip_ci) }}
56	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
57	    timeout-minutes: 15
58	    steps:
59	      - name: Checkout repository
60	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
61	
62	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
63	        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
64	        with:
65	          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
66	          cache: yarn
67	
68	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
69	        run: corepack enable
70	
71	      - name: Install dependencies
72	        run: yarn install --immutable
73	
74	      - name: Lint
75	        run: yarn lint
76	
77	      - name: Type check
78	        run: yarn typecheck
79	
80	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
81	  # Unit tests (skipped when skip_tests or skip_ci)
82	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
83	  unit-tests:
84	    name: Unit tests
85	    if: >-
86	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
87	        (inputs.skip_tests || inputs.skip_ci))
88	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
89	    timeout-minutes: 15
90	    steps:
91	      - name: Checkout repository
92	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
93	
94	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
95	        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
96	        with:
97	          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
98	          cache: yarn
99	
100	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
101	        run: corepack enable
102	
103	      - name: Install dependencies
104	        run: yarn install --immutable
105	
106	      - name: Run unit tests
107	        env:
108	          CI: true
109	        run: yarn test
110	
111	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
112	  # Build + E2E tests (skipped when skip_e2e, skip_tests, or skip_ci)
113	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
114	  e2e-tests:
115	    name: Build & E2E tests
116	    if: >-
117	      github.ref_name == 'main' &&
118	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
119	        (inputs.skip_e2e || inputs.skip_tests || inputs.skip_ci))
120	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
121	    timeout-minutes: 30
122	    steps:
123	      - name: Checkout repository
124	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
125	
126	      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
127	        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
128	        with:
129	          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
130	          cache: yarn
131	
132	      - name: Enable Corepack (Yarn 4)
133	        run: corepack enable
134	
135	      - name: Install dependencies
136	        run: yarn install --immutable
137	
138	      - name: Generate service worker and robots.txt (prebuild)
139	        env:
140	          BUILD_VERSION: ${{ github.sha }}
141	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
142	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
143	        run: yarn prebuild
144	
145	      - name: Build Next.js application
146	        env:
147	          NODE_ENV: production
148	          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
149	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
150	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
151	          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
152	        run: yarn build
153	
154	      - name: Install Playwright browsers
155	        run: npx playwright install chromium --with-deps
156	
157	      - name: Start Next.js server (background)
158	        run: |
159	          yarn start &
160	          echo $! > .next-server.pid
161	          echo "Started Next.js server with PID $(cat .next-server.pid)"
162	        env:
163	          NODE_ENV: production
164	          PORT: 3000
165	          E2E_TEST_MODE: "1"
166	          NEXT_PUBLIC_E2E_TEST_MODE: "1"
167	          HMAC_SECRET: ${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
168	          NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: ${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
169	          NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL: https://www.esdeveniments.cat
170	          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}
171	
172	      - name: Wait for server to be ready
173	        run: npx wait-on http://localhost:3000 --timeout 60000
174	
175	      - name: Sanity check robots.txt
176	        run: |
177	          set -euo pipefail
178	          robots="$(curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/robots.txt)"
179	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "allow: /" > /dev/null
180	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "disallow: /_next/" > /dev/null
181	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "disallow: /api/" > /dev/null
182	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "user-agent: gptbot" > /dev/null
183	          echo "$robots" | grep -F -i "sitemap: https://www.esdeveniments.cat/server-static-sitemap.xml" > /dev/null
184	          echo "robots.txt looks correct"
185	
186	      - name: Run E2E tests
187	        run: yarn test:e2e -c playwright.remote.config.ts --workers=2
188	        env:
189	          CI: true
190	          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
191	
192	      - name: Stop Next.js server
193	        if: always()
194	        run: |
195	          if [ -f .next-server.pid ]; then
196	            kill $(cat .next-server.pid) || true
197	            rm .next-server.pid
198	          fi
199	          pkill -f "yarn start" || true
200	
201	      - name: Upload Playwright report (on failure)
202	        if: failure()
203	        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
204	        with:
205	          name: playwright-report-deploy
206	          path: playwright-report/
207	          retention-days: 7
208	          if-no-files-found: ignore
209	
210	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
211	  # Build the production image on a GitHub runner and push it to GHCR.
212	  # The heavy Next.js build used to run on the shared Coolify host and
213	  # starved prod of CPU during deploys; building here keeps it off-box.
214	  # Coolify then deploys this prebuilt image (Docker Image source).
215	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
216	  build-and-push:
217	    name: Build & push image
218	    needs: [quality, unit-tests, e2e-tests]
219	    # Build only when the CI jobs that ran passed (mirrors the deploy gate).
220	    if: >-
221	      always() &&
222	      !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.skip_ci) &&
223	      (needs.quality.result == 'success' || needs.quality.result == 'skipped') &&
224	      (needs.unit-tests.result == 'success' || needs.unit-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
225	      (needs.e2e-tests.result == 'success' || needs.e2e-tests.result == 'skipped')
226	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
227	    timeout-minutes: 30
228	    permissions:
229	      contents: read
230	      packages: write
231	    # Environment-scoped secrets let the develop (staging) build inline its own
232	    # NEXT_PUBLIC_* values, overriding the repo-level prod defaults.
233	    environment:
234	      name: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}
235	    steps:
236	      - name: Checkout repository
237	        uses: actions/checkout@v7
238	
239	      - name: Compute lowercase image name
240	        id: meta
241	        run: echo "image=ghcr.io/$(echo '${{ github.repository }}' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
242	
243	      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
244	        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
245	
246	      - name: Log in to GitHub Container Registry
247	        uses: docker/login-action@v3
248	        with:
249	          registry: ghcr.io
250	          username: ${{ github.actor }}
251	          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
252	
253	      - name: Build and push image
254	        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
255	        with:
256	          context: .
257	          push: true
258	          tags: |
259	            ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:${{ github.ref_name }}
260	            ${{ steps.meta.outputs.image }}:sha-${{ github.sha }}
261	          cache-from: type=gha
262	          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
263	          # NEXT_PUBLIC_* are inlined into the client bundle (public by design).
264	          # HMAC_SECRET / SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN are used only in the builder stage and
265	          # do not persist in the final runner image (multi-stage Dockerfile).
266	          build-args: |
267	            BUILD_VERSION=${{ github.sha }}
268	            NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL }}
269	            NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL }}
270	            NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN }}
271	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANALYTICS }}
272	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ADS }}
273	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION }}
274	            NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS }}
275	            NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY }}
276	            NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_TIKTOK_REDIRECT_URI }}
277	            NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY=${{ secrets.NEXT_PUBLIC_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY }}
278	            HMAC_SECRET=${{ secrets.HMAC_SECRET }}
279	            SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN=${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
280	            SENTRY_ORG=${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
281	            SENTRY_PROJECT=${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
282	
283	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
284	  # Deploy to Coolify (waits for whichever CI jobs actually ran)
285	  # -----------------------------------------------------------------
286	  deploy:
287	    name: Deploy to Coolify
288	    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
289	    needs: [quality, unit-tests, e2e-tests, build-and-push]
290	    # Run deploy if all non-skipped jobs succeeded.
291	    # `always()` lets us proceed when skipped jobs report as skipped (not failed).
292	    if: >-
293	      always() &&
294	      (needs.quality.result == 'success' || needs.quality.result == 'skipped') &&
295	      (needs.unit-tests.result == 'success' || needs.unit-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
296	      (needs.e2e-tests.result == 'success' || needs.e2e-tests.result == 'skipped') &&
297	      (needs.build-and-push.result == 'success' || needs.build-and-push.result == 'skipped')
298	    # 20 min = 15 min MAX_WAIT for Coolify build (prod Next.js + Docker rebuilds
299	    # run ~12 min) + ~5 min for webhook trigger, smoke tests, and runner overhead.
300	    timeout-minutes: 20
301	    # GitHub Environment enables protection rules, required reviewers, and environment-specific secrets
302	    environment:
303	      name: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && 'production' || 'staging' }}
304	      url: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}
305	
306	    steps:
307	      - name: Deployment mode summary
308	        run: |
309	          echo "## Deployment Mode" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
310	          echo "| Check | Status |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
311	          echo "|-------|--------|" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
312	          echo "| Quality (lint+typecheck) | ${{ needs.quality.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
313	          echo "| Unit tests | ${{ needs.unit-tests.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
314	          echo "| E2E tests | ${{ needs.e2e-tests.result }} |" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
315	          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
316	          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
317	            echo "**Trigger:** Manual dispatch" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
318	            echo "- skip_e2e: ${{ inputs.skip_e2e }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
319	            echo "- skip_tests: ${{ inputs.skip_tests }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
320	            echo "- skip_ci: ${{ inputs.skip_ci }}" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
321	          else
322	            echo "**Trigger:** Push to ${{ github.ref_name }} ($([ '${{ github.ref_name }}' = 'main' ] && echo 'full CI' || echo 'lint+typecheck+unit'))" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
323	          fi
324	
325	      # Coolify's app config points at the floating `:main` registry tag. A
326	      # health-check-triggered container restart recreates the container
327	      # from whatever image is locally cached under that tag WITHOUT going
328	      # through this deploy pipeline — so a restart can silently resurrect
329	      # stale code hours after a correct deploy, with no CI run, webhook, or
330	      # API call to show for it. This happened on 2026-07-31: the RSC
331	      # cache-poisoning fix (0cdf6f8e) deployed correctly at 14:34 UTC, then
332	      # a restart at 19:01 UTC reverted it. Pinning to the immutable
333	      # `sha-<commit>` tag (already pushed by build-and-push, above) before
334	      # every deploy removes the floating tag a restart could resurrect.
335	      # See docs/incidents/2026-04-04-cloudflare-rsc-cache-poisoning.md.
336	      - name: Pin Coolify to this commit's immutable image tag
337	        env:
338	          COOLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN || secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}
339	          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL || secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING }}
340	        run: |
341	          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
342	            echo "::error::COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL secret is required"
343	            exit 1
344	          fi
345	
346	          # The webhook URL is Coolify's own `POST /api/v1/deploy?uuid=...`
347	          # trigger — reuse its host and uuid instead of adding new secrets.
348	          COOLIFY_API_BASE=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '^https?://[^/]+')
349	          COOLIFY_APP_UUID=$(echo "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" | grep -oP '(?<=[?&]uuid=)[^&]+')
350	
351	          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_API_BASE" ] || [ -z "$COOLIFY_APP_UUID" ]; then
352	            echo "::error::Could not parse host/uuid out of COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL — expected .../api/v1/deploy?uuid=<uuid>. Refusing to deploy on the floating tag; fix the URL or this parsing."
353	            exit 1
354	          fi
355	
356	          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
357	            -X PATCH "${COOLIFY_API_BASE}/api/v1/applications/${COOLIFY_APP_UUID}" \
358	            -H "Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN" \
359	            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
360	            --data "{\"docker_registry_image_tag\": \"sha-${{ github.sha }}\"}" \
361	            --max-time 15) || HTTP_CODE="000"
362	
363	          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 200 ] || [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 300 ]; then
364	            echo "::error::Failed to pin docker_registry_image_tag (HTTP $HTTP_CODE) — aborting rather than deploying on the floating :main tag"
365	            cat /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json 2>/dev/null || true
366	            exit 1
367	          fi
368	
369	          echo "Pinned esdeveniments-production to sha-${{ github.sha }}"
370	
371	      - name: Trigger Coolify deployment
372	        env:
373	          COOLIFY_TOKEN: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN || secrets.COOLIFY_TOKEN_STAGING }}
374	          COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ github.ref_name == 'main' && secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL || secrets.COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL_STAGING }}
375	        run: |
376	          if [ -z "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
377	            echo "::error::COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL secret is required"
378	            exit 1
379	          fi
380	
381	          # Trigger deployment via Coolify webhook with retries
382	          MAX_RETRIES=3
383	          RETRY_DELAY=5
384	          for attempt in $(seq 1 $MAX_RETRIES); do
385	            HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /tmp/coolify-response.json -w "%{http_code}" \
386	              -X POST "$COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL" \
387	              -H "Authorization: Bearer $COOLIFY_TOKEN" \
388	              -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
389	              --max-time 30) || HTTP_CODE="000"
390	
391	            echo "Attempt $attempt: Coolify API response HTTP $HTTP_CODE"
392	
393	            if [ "$HTTP_CODE" -ge 200 ] && [ "$HTTP_CODE" -lt 300 ]; then
394	              echo "Deployment triggered successfully"
395	              exit 0
396	            fi
397	
398	            if [ "$attempt" -lt "$MAX_RETRIES" ]; then
399	              echo "Retrying in ${RETRY_DELAY}s..."
400	              sleep $RETRY_DELAY
401	              RETRY_DELAY=$((RETRY_DELAY * 2))
402	            fi
403	          done
404	
405	          echo "::error::Coolify deployment trigger failed after $MAX_RETRIES attempts (last HTTP $HTTP_CODE)"
406	          cat /tmp/coolify-response.json 2>/dev/null || true
407	          exit 1
408	
409	      - name: Wait for Coolify deployment to complete
410	        env:
411	          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}
412	          EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ github.sha }}
413	          SITE_URL: ${{ env.DEPLOY_URL }}
414	        run: |
415	          echo "Waiting for Coolify deployment..."
416	          # Poll health endpoint until the new container is live. Requires
417	          # BUILD_VERSION=$SOURCE_COMMIT to be set as a build variable in the
418	          # Coolify dashboard → Application → Environment so /api/health
419	          # exposes the running commit SHA.
420	          #
421	          # Prod Next.js + Docker rebuilds on Coolify run ~12 minutes. Too-short
422	          # a MAX_WAIT fails the step (and skips the CDN purge + smoke tests)
423	          # even though the deploy then succeeds — a false negative.
424	          MAX_WAIT=900  # 15 minutes — covers the ~12 min full rebuild with margin
425	          INTERVAL=10
426	          ELAPSED=0
427	          DEPLOY_CONFIRMED=0
428	
429	          # Initial wait for Coolify to start building
430	          sleep 15
431	          ELAPSED=15
432	
433	          # Record the current live version before deployment
434	          PRE_DEPLOY_VERSION=$(curl -s --max-time 5 \
435	            "${SITE_URL}/api/health?secret=${REVALIDATE_SECRET}" \
436	            | grep -o '"buildVersion":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4) || PRE_DEPLOY_VERSION=""
437	
438	          while [ $ELAPSED -lt $MAX_WAIT ]; do
439	            RESPONSE=$(curl -s --max-time 5 \
440	              "${SITE_URL}/api/health?secret=${REVALIDATE_SECRET}") || RESPONSE=""
441	
442	            LIVE_VERSION=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"buildVersion":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4) || LIVE_VERSION=""
443	            HTTP_OK=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep -o '"status":"healthy"') || HTTP_OK=""
444

Possible causes: (1) a rapid subsequent push caused Coolify to process webhooks out of order; (2) a prior failed build retried mid-poll. Re-run the workflow or push again."

499	          if [ "$HTTP_CODE" = "200" ]; then

501	          else

504	          fi

506	      - name: Post-deploy smoke tests
507	        env:
508	          REVALIDATE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.REVALIDATE_SECRET }}

523	          fi
524	
525	          HTTP_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 10 "${SITE_URL}/barcelona") || HTTP_CODE="000"

527	            echo "Barcelona page: OK"

566	            echo "::error::Post-deploy smoke tests failed — deployment may be broken"

568	          fi
569	
570	      - name: Deployment summary

572	        run: |

I've read the full workflow file and analyzed the diff carefully. Let me trace the new step:

**Entry point**: Deploy job step, runs on push to main/develop or workflow_dispatch (not `pull_request_target` — no untrusted-fork exposure).

**Sinks in the diff**:
1. `curl PATCH` to Coolify API — auth Bearer token
2. Shell string built from `github.sha` and Coolify secrets
3. `cat /tmp/coolify-patch-response.json` on error (log exposure)

**Data flow**:
- `github.sha` — always a 40-char hex; safe in JSON/shell.
- `COOLIFY_TOKEN`, `COOLIFY_WEBHOOK_URL` — repository secrets, trusted, and GitHub Actions auto-redacts them from any log output (including the response body cat).
- `COOLIFY_API_BASE`/`COOLIFY_APP_UUID` — parsed from the trusted secret URL. Regexes are anchored (`^https?://[^/]+`) and constrained (`[^&]+`). Only concern would be an operator-misconfigured URL, not attacker-controlled.
- The URL parsing does allow `http://` (regex `https?`) — hardening gap, not a concrete vulnerability given the source is a trusted secret.
- `HTTP_CODE` check is fail-closed (`-lt 200 || -ge 300 → exit 1`), and curl error also forces `HTTP_CODE=000` which correctly triggers the failure path.
- Concurrency group `deploy-coolify-${{ github.ref }}` with `cancel-in-progress: true` prevents PATCH-vs-trigger races on the same ref.

**Phase 2c checks**:
- CI/CD TRUST: no new workflow_dispatch/pull_request_target trigger added; only a new step in an existing push-triggered workflow.
- UNDER-VALIDATED SINK ARG: only `github.sha` is interpolated into the JSON/URL sink — provably hex.
- SENSITIVE-TO-OBSERVABILITY: `cat` on error output — but secrets are auto-redacted, and Coolify's application-config PATCH response is admin-metadata, not user data.
- FAIL-OPEN STATE DRIFT: all error paths (empty URL, unparseable URL, non-2xx, curl error) fail closed with `exit 1` — no path silently proceeds to the webhook trigger on the floating `:main` tag. Good.
- GATE/ACTION FIELD MISMATCH: PATCH sets `docker_registry_image_tag`, then trigger step POSTs to the deploy webhook — same app UUID derived from the same secret. No mismatch.
- ALLOWLIST SEMANTIC ESCAPE / OVER-BROAD GRANT / STALE IDENTITY / SECURITY-REGISTRY FANOUT: N/A to this change.
- CONTROL REGRESSION: no `-` lines that delete a validator.

**Conclusion**: This change is defensive — it closes a stale-image resurrection risk by pinning the immutable `sha-<commit>` tag before triggering the webhook. The parsing is bounded, all failure paths fail closed, and every interpolated value is either a trusted secret or a guaranteed-hex `github.sha`. No new vulnerabilities introduced.
